universe.unchanged: the frozen set is NOT modified by alias resolution

rule: massive_ticker is the CANONICAL OPERATIONAL TICKER. Everywhere the programme says 'ticker' without qualification, it means massive_ticker. snapshot_ticker is provenance only.

may_not: silently drop a security that fails to resolve
invariants.unresolved_semantics: UNRESOLVED is not NOT_AVAILABLE and is not DROP; ingestion for that security is HOLD until resolved

order: exact ticker (corroborated by CIK where both sides carry one)
punctuation variant ONLY when the CIK agrees
matching.why_cik: a punctuation guess can silently land on a different live issuer that happens to own the string; CIK is issuer identity and is indifferent to vendor punctuation
matching.rejected_by_design: accepting a punctuation variant on the strength of it returning data

source.credential: MASSIVE_API_KEY read from backend/.env; never printed, logged, or stored in this artifact
